#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class MinCostMaxFlow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int u, flow, cost, rid;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), cost(c), rid(d) {}
    };

    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    const int gmax = INT_MAX / 100;
    vector<vector<Edge>> al;
    vector<vector<Edge>> ja;
    vector<int> d;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) : N(n), S(source), T(sink), maxFlow(0), minCost(0) {
        al.resize(N);
        d.resize(N, 0);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
        al[u].emplace_back(v, flow, cost, lv);
        al[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, lu);
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        ja.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            ja[i] = move(al[i]);
            al[i].clear();
        }
    }

    struct BinaryHeap {
        vector<int> heap;
        vector<int> pos;
        int size;
        const vector<int>& dist; // reference to dist array

        BinaryHeap(int n, const vector<int>& d) : heap(n), pos(n, -1), size(0), dist(d) {}

        void push(int v, int dist_v) {
            if (pos[v] == -1) {
                pos[v] = size;
                heap[size] = v;
                size++;
            }
            int i = pos[v];
            while (i > 0) {
                int p = (i - 1) / 2;
                if (dist[heap[p]] <= dist[v]) break;
                swap(i, p);
                i = p;
            }
        }

        int pop() {
            int ret = heap[0];
            size--;
            heap[0] = heap[size];
            pos[heap[0]] = 0;
            int i = 0;
            while (true) {
                int left = 2 * i + 1;
                int right = 2 * i + 2;
                int smallest = i;
                if (left < size && dist[heap[left]] < dist[heap[smallest]]) smallest = left;
                if (right < size && dist[heap[right]] < dist[heap[smallest]]) smallest = right;
                if (smallest == i) break;
                swap(i, smallest);
                i = smallest;
            }
            pos[ret] = -1;
            return ret;
        }

        bool isEmpty() const { return size == 0; }

        void swap(int i, int j) {
            int tmp = heap[i];
            heap[i] = heap[j];
            heap[j] = tmp;
            pos[heap[i]] = i;
            pos[heap[j]] = j;
        }
    };

    vector<int> dist, prv, prve, visit;

    bool dijkstra() {
        visit.assign(N, 0);
        prv.assign(N, -1);
        prve.assign(N, -1);
        dist.assign(N, gmax);
        BinaryHeap pq(N, dist);
        pq.push(S, 0);
        dist[S] = 0;
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            int u = pq.pop();
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge& e = ja[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int nd = dist[u] + e.cost + d[u] - d[e.u];
                if (nd < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                    dist[e.u] = nd;
                    prv[e.u] = u;
                    prve[e.u] = i;
                    pq.push(e.u, nd);
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T;
        int minf = gmax;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
            minf = min(minf, val);
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            ja[pp][pe].flow -= minf;
            ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += minf;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += minf;
        return minf;
    }

    void updPotential() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (visit[i] != 0) {
                d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int minc = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
            minCost += minc * augment();
            updPotential();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);

    vector<int> a(k + 1), f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        f[a[i]]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (f[i] == 0) continue;
        ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                if (a != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + a, n * (l + 1) + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (b != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + b, n * (l + 1) + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
        ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }
    ans.convertToArray();
    ans.calWithPotential();
    if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
        cout << "BUG\n";
    } else {
        cout << (int)ans.minCost << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
